commits.message:
Non-standard names renamed to their industry-standard terms (0.29.0, breaking) (#540)

* Non-standard names renamed to their industry-standard terms (rich-unfiled-791c.29ge)

The interval a sampled value stays the same is ValidityInterval (validFrom, validUntil), not Hold; step durations are StepSequence, not Beat; a renderable handed no column is hidden, not held; the separator protocol is Separator; palette adjustment is adjust, not transpose; the spelling is color throughout. Effects and widgets follow: sampleAndHold, WidgetKeyEvent, KeyEvent, WheelEvent, TerminalMouseEvent, EndCaps, SeparatorSeam, CellSeparator, mask, reorder, labeled, namedCharacterReference, rapidBlink, doubleUnderline, ensureContrast, compositedColor, adjustPalette, isHueLocked. No old name is kept as an alias or deprecated export. Breaking: 0.29.0.

* Review fixes: a clobbered sentence, widget comments, helper names, articles, docs theme spelling (rich-unfiled-791c.29ge)

The review of 7bb19d153 found a sentence where the verb Hold had been renamed to ValidityInterval (now Keep), widget-class comments that still said KeyEvent (now WidgetKeyEvent), test helpers named nextChangeOf and lastChangeOf (now validUntilOf and validFromOf), two uses of 'a OutputTarget' (now an), and colour spellings in the docs theme comments. Findings that were rejected: the removed old names are the intended break; the app.ts ask findings are not in this diff; the go-template-js peer range is already ^0.12.0 on origin/master.
